responsibility: Provides the shared implementation layer used by the various RTL generator programs. It manages machine-description queues, pattern statistics, predicate validation, operand and clobber analysis, optab matching, condition handling, and utility constructors such as `gen_rtx_CONST_INT`, giving the generator executables a common set of parsing and transformation services.
same_name_distinction: Implementation side of the gen* support layer declared in gcc/gensupport.h. Unlike the header, this file provides the actual shared machinery for generator programs: .md pattern queues and condition tables, predicate and operand analysis, optab-pattern matching, pattern statistics, and helper routines such as `gen_rtx_CONST_INT`, `get_emit_function`, and `find_optab`.
